test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, number, symbol series and answer the question that follows.

(Left) H T Z C T & T * % 7 & Y % 6 U K & 2 R T 7 9 Y S 3 5 E * S & D 9 # 6 * (Right)

If all the numbers are dropped/deleted from the series, which of the following will be fourth to the left of sixth from the right?
solution:
Given terms: (Left) H T Z C T & T * % 7 & Y % 6 U K & 2 R T 7 9 Y S 3 5 E * S & D 9 # 6 * (Right)

If all the numbers are dropped from the series then the arrangements are:

(Left) H T Z C T & T * % & Y % U K & R T Y S E * S & D # * (Right)

Here,

Sixth from the right end is: *

And fourth to the left of sixth from the right end is: T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
